Flight Control v1.4.0 was released 2026-11-09 (v1.3.2 on 2026-11-05); repo is Apache-2.0; the top eight contributors have 237-665 commits each (asafbennatan 665, hexfusion 519, avishayt 518, galel12 337, fzdarsky 308, DakCrowder 276, mangelajo 248, ori-amizur 237)

Flight Control supports TPM 2.0 device identity: the agent creates a Local Attestation Key and a Local Device Identity (LDevID) in the TPM, validates the chain to the TPM manufacturer's EK certificate, and follows TCG 'TPM 2.0 Keys for Device Identity and Attestation' v1.10 section 6.6

Flight Control ships a devicesimulator (cmd/devicesimulator) that launches many independent flightctl-agent processes (--count, --max-concurrency default 100) with Prometheus metrics for load testing, and a Helm pre-upgrade scale job; no published 10k-device result was found in the repo
